request.instruction: Rewrite ONLY [AUTHORIZED_SPAN] of the contract paragraph so that EVERY listed obligation is carried out at the same time. Keep all text outside the authorized span byte-identical. Preserve fee rates, percentages, amounts, dates, subjects, formulas, accounts, share classes and every fee topic unless an obligation explicitly removes it. Do not introduce a number that is not in the source, the guide text or the verified facts. Return the complete replacement for the span, not a diff. List the source literals you preserved.

response.basis: G12 requires replacing the redemption-fee clause with the exact wording that the redemption fee is borne by the redeeming holder, collected at redemption, and fully included in fund assets. G13 requires deleting the separate sentence imposing a minimum 1.5% fee on holders with holding periods under 7 days and including it in fund assets. The authorized span contains only the tail of that sentence, so the replacement adopts the G12 wording, which omits the 7-day/1.5% provision, thereby satisfying both obligations without introducing new numbers.
